doc_name: 汽车产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 必须加快汽车产业调整和振兴
quote_en: The adjustment and revitalisation of the auto industry must be accelerated.
notes: Headline of a dedicated plan (target: 2009 output/sales above 10 million units). Support instruments: purchase-tax cut to 5% for cars of 1.6 L and below, 汽车下乡, scrappage subsidies, scrapping local purchase limits. Restriction side (minor): new vehicle makers and out-of-region branches only via acquiring existing makers; exit mechanism for non-compliant makers.

doc_name: 汽车产业调整和振兴规划
notes: Target: 500,000 units of NEV capacity and about 5% of passenger-car sales; demonstration programme with central subsidies.

doc_name: 汽车产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 建立动力模块生产体系，形成10亿安时（Ah）车用高性能单体动力电池生产能力
quote_en: Build a power-module production system and a 1 billion Ah capacity of high-performance traction cells.

doc_name: 汽车产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 支持汽车零部件骨干企业通过兼并重组扩大规模，提高国内外汽车配套市场份额
quote_en: Support leading parts makers to scale up through M&A and raise domestic and overseas OEM-supply share.
notes: Also: 关键零部件技术实现自主化; 发展提升整车性能的关键零部件.

doc_name: 汽车产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 加快发展汽车研发、生产性物流、汽车零售和售后服务、汽车租赁、二手车交易
quote_en: Accelerate development of auto R&D, production logistics, retail and after-sales, rental and used-car trading.
notes: Dedicated task (八) 发展现代汽车服务业. List continues with 汽车保险、消费信贷、停车服务、报废回收; parking: 推动停车场建设，规范停车收费.

doc_name: 汽车产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 大力发展专业的二手车经销企业
notes: Dedicated policy item (六). Regulatory side: 取消二手车交易市场的不合理收费; 加强二手车市场监管，严格经营主体市场准入.

doc_name: 汽车产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 支持符合条件的国内骨干汽车生产企业建立汽车金融公司
quote_en: Support qualified domestic leading carmakers in establishing auto-finance companies.
notes: Also 促进和规范汽车消费信贷, securitisation of auto-loan assets. Mapping to 多元金融 is a judgement.

doc_name: 汽车产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 研究制订三轮汽车和低速货车生产企业向相关产业转型的鼓励办法
quote_en: Study and draw up incentives for makers of three-wheelers and low-speed trucks to convert to related industries.
notes: Same policy item: 落实汽车整车（含摩托车、三轮汽车、低速货车）生产企业退出机制 (motorcycles 801881 included in the exit mechanism).

doc_name: 汽车产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 鼓励加快城市轨道交通设施建设
quote_en: Encourage faster construction of urban rail-transit facilities.
notes: Peripheral item in the urban-transport-system policy; mapped to infrastructure construction (judgement).

doc_name: 汽车产业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 建立电动汽车快速充电网络，加快停车场等公共场所公用充电设施建设
quote_en: Build an EV fast-charging network and speed up public charging facilities in car parks and other public places.
notes: L2 left none: charging-equipment placement within 电力设备 is unclear.
